title: AI GLADE House Model
description: Parametric description of a house. This is the contract between the model layer, the Blender generator and (later) the MCP server. Geometry is always derived from this document - never the other way round.

schema_version.description: Bumped when a breaking change lands. Readers must reject a version they do not understand.

floors.description: One entry per storey, ordered by level.

width.description: Footprint along X, in metres. Every room must fit inside [0, width].

depth.description: Footprint along Y, in metres. Every room must fit inside [0, depth].

floors.description: Storey count. Informational - the authoritative list is the top-level 'floors' array.

style.description: Visual style. Milestone 1 only distinguishes stone vs plaster walls.

stone_walls.description: Enable the experimental Geometry Nodes stone scatter on walls.

terrain_margin.description: Ground plane extent beyond the footprint, in metres.

seed.description: Drives terrain noise and tree placement. Same seed => same scene.

level.description: 0 is the ground floor. Must be unique across the house.

height.description: Storey height in metres. Every opening on this floor must be shorter than this.

rooms.description: Rooms must not overlap. Walls are DERIVED from these rectangles; walls shared by two adjacent rooms are generated once.

room.description: An axis-aligned rectangular room. (x, y) is its south-west corner.

name.description: Unique within its floor. Used to build wall ids.

wall.description: Derived wall id, e.g. 'L0_salon:south'. Format: L<level>_<room>:<side>, with a trailing _<n> when a neighbour splits that side into several segments.

position.description: Normalised position along the wall (0 = start, 1 = end). Normalised on purpose: the opening keeps its relative place when the wall is resized.

sill.description: Height of the bottom edge above the floor. Must be 0 for doors.

type.description: Milestone 1 implements gable (dos aguas) only. hip / flat / tower are Milestone 2 (README 12 V2).

pitch.description: Slope in degrees. Ridge height above the wall top = (span / 2) * tan(pitch).

ridge_axis.description: 'auto' runs the ridge along the longer footprint side.
